title: Signatures
description: Tagline, email signature, initials and stamp automatically reuse the project's name, logo and colours.

slogan.withLogoBody: Your favourite logo combined with the chosen tagline, ready to export.
slogan.noLogo: Generate a logo first to combine it with the tagline.
slogan.similarWarning: Taglines too close to a known one are flagged by the server.

email.legalPlaceholder: E.g. Registered association no. …, RCCM …, confidentiality notice
email.copied: Signature copied: paste it in your email settings.
email.imageNote: In the final version, the logo is served as a PNG from an absolute HTTPS URL, compatible with every email client.

guides.gmail: Gmail: Settings › See all settings › General › Signature › Create new, then paste.
guides.outlook: Outlook (desktop): File › Options › Mail › Signatures › New, then paste.
guides.outlookWeb: Outlook (web): Settings › Mail › Compose and reply › Email signature, then paste.
guides.apple: Apple Mail: Mail › Settings › Signatures › +, untick “Always match my default message font”, then paste.
guides.thunderbird: Thunderbird: Account settings › Signature text › tick “Use HTML”, then paste the HTML code.

email.batchBody: Columns: name, title, email, phone. A ZIP archive contains one HTML signature per member.
email.batchDone: {count, plural, one {# signature generated} other {# signatures generated}}
email.batchProOnly: Batch signatures are included in the Pro and Agency plans.

handwritten.drawHint: Draw your initials in the frame. The stroke is smoothed then vectorised, transparent background.

stamp.pending: This stamp contains official terms ({terms}): it will be reviewed manually before being available.
stamp.officialWarning: Official terms detected: {terms}. The stamp will go through manual review.

security.notLegal: Initials and stamps are images: they do not have the value of a qualified electronic signature.
security.attest: I certify that I own this name or am authorised to represent the organisation.
security.private: Private file, served through a short-lived signed link.
